title: Messenger configuration
description: Body of GET /v1/mobile/config: the inbox's published appearance (appearance.json) in one language, with what the server works out around it. The SDK keeps it on disk, uses it at once on the next launch and checks it in the background with If-None-Match; config.changed says when to fetch it again.

version.description: The published appearance version; every publish adds one.

initial.description: What stands in for a missing logo: the name's first letter or digit, upper case ("TANZ" MMC gives T); empty when there is none. An SDK's own fallback picks it the same way.

logo_dark_url.description: For dark mode; null: the logo.

logo_scale.description: The logo's height on Home in percent of 32, the wordmark's too (still at most 60% of the screen wide). Absent: 100. No logo: the place stays empty, no initial.

logo_style.description: wordmark: draw wordmark_url (wordmark_dark_url in dark mode, else wordmark_url) in place of the logo and the name in Home's header only, 32 high, at most 60% of the header's width, fitted, never cut or stretched; space kept while it loads; the mark with the name if it fails to load; brand.name as its accessibility label. The conversation's header always keeps the mark (small logo or initial and the name). Sent as wordmark only with a wordmark_url. Absent or unknown: mark.

wordmark_url.description: The full written logo, transparent; at most 1200 wide (?w=300|600|1200).

wordmark_dark_url.description: For dark mode; null: the wordmark.

header_image_url.description: header_style image: the SDK draws a dark overlay (black 35% to 55%, top to bottom) and white text on it.

glow.description: A soft radial glow of the brand colour (25%) behind the header.

colors.description: Worked out by the server from primary_color, so both SDKs show the same; an SDK's own math is only a fallback for when there is no config.

mode.description: auto: the inbox's three most recently active agents; manual: pictures uploaded in the panel.

reply_time_offline.description: Shown instead of reply_time outside working hours.

next_open_at.description: UTC. Outside working hours, when they next begin (the SDK shows strings.away_until with the local time); null while open.

name.description: The panel's bot name, else brand.name. A message's bot sender is named by the same rule, its own name (Clomni AI, an agent bot) coming before brand.name.

avatar_url.description: null: the brand logo, and without one the name's first letter.

title_scale.description: The greeting's size in percent: both lines are 28 times this (first line semibold in primary_strong at about 70%, second bold in header_text), line height 1.2, left-aligned, about 80% of the screen wide; the system font scale (Dynamic Type, fontScale) applies on top and long text wraps, never cut. Absent: 100.

cards.description: In the order shown. messages (opens the conversation list, also with a tab bar) and send are always there. news: the first news_on_home published news (GET /news), see_all under them only when there are more, not drawn when there is none. faq: the first three questions (GET /faq), see_all under them only when there are more, drawn only while faq.enabled and there is a question. An SDK skips a card it does not know.

tab_bar.description: SDK 1.0.7. true: tabs at the bottom of the list screens, in this order: home (strings.tab_home), messages (tab_messages, with the unread count), news (tab_news, only while there is a published news item), faq (tab_faq, only while faq.enabled and there is a question). A conversation's screen hides the bar. false or absent: no tab bar; the messages card opens the conversation list and the news card's see_all the news list.

news_on_home.description: SDK 1.0.7. How many news items Home's news card shows. see_all (strings.see_all) under them, only when there are more news than this, leads to the news tab, or to the news list without a tab bar. Absent: 2.

type.description: instagram, whatsapp, facebook, telegram, linkedin, tiktok, email, phone; an SDK skips a type it does not know.

enabled.description: Off unless the customer turns it on.

starts_with_flow.description: true when the inbox has a live, published flow for new conversations that reaches this platform. The SDK then creates the conversation (POST /conversations with a client_id) as soon as the user opens a new one, without waiting for a first message, and shows the flow's first messages from the response. Absent means false.

single.description: The inbox keeps a user to one conversation at a time (its "lock to single conversation" setting; SDK 1.0.7). While true, every way of starting a new conversation (the send card, the new conversation button in the list, Clomni.present) opens GET /conversations' resume_conversation_id with its history instead of an empty new one, and a new conversation when that is null. The SDK goes by that id alone and applies no rule of its own: the server decides which conversation it is, by the same rule POST /conversations answers with. Before deciding, the SDK waits for the conversations list. An SDK answered an id other than the one it opened moves its screen there, which stays the fallback for a race. false: a new conversation as before. Absent means false.

sounds.description: Play the send and receive sounds. Set in the panel (Theme, Sounds); absent means true.

languages.description: Set in the panel (Appearance, Languages). The SDK speaks the host's setLanguage if it is enabled, else the device's language if it is enabled, else default. strings is in the language asked for (?lang=) when it is enabled, else in default.

voice_seconds.description: The longest voice message; the recorder stops there. An SDK uses 300 when it is absent.

powered_by.description: Show "Powered by Clomni" under Home; false only on a plan that allows it.

faq.description: SDK 1.0.7. The questions the panel shares (GET /faq): the faq tab and the faq card. Absent: off.

image_url.description: Takes ?w= (48, 96 or 144 for a logo or avatar; 360, 720 or 1080 for the header picture; the largest when left out) and &format=webp|png (png when left out).

primary.description: Dark mode: one step (10 points of HSL lightness) lighter than the brand colour.

primary_strong.description: Home's first greeting line, drawn at about 70% opacity: the brand two steps (20 points of HSL lightness) darker, or lighter for a brand white reads on at 7:1. The same in both modes.

on_primary.description: White when it reaches 4.5:1 on primary, otherwise black.

primary_soft.description: primary at 10% over the background (#FFFFFF, dark #121316): soft fills, image placeholders.

primary_line.description: primary at 22% over the background: pill borders.

header_text.description: Text and icons on the header: white when it reaches 3:1 on both header_from and header_to (large text), otherwise #1B1D21; always white over a header picture. The greeting's first line is this at 62% opacity.
